n<=3 episodes per cell, unit = episode, descriptive, no p-values

STATUS_NUDGES: is it done? what happens now with my request
so is my request processed or not
client.rule: agent reply without question and without slots, scenario exhausted, intent != question_only, nudges < K -> next STATUS_NUDGE; after K -> end_reason agent_stalled
client.assumption: a real customer who got a promise without action asks for the status up to K=2 times (no data; recorded in simplifications)

offline_expectations.patient_compare: scripts/rev8_patient_compare.py: stub 2/2r, 2712 legal episodes per foundation, facts (saved rev7 table) vs facts_patient. Expected before the run: 0 changes of task_status, 0 new unneeded_escalation on GT info_request/no_action, (N2) no increase of violation/wrong_resolution on GT refusal. Any difference is published as a found defect of the mechanism
offline_expectations.order_scope: scripts/rev8_order_scope_diag.py: stub 2r, published with any value incl. 0; measures corpus composition and the stub, not the model (N4)

archetypes.name: high_value
archetypes.select_rule: 3 smallest entry_index >= position of the entry in the corpus with pairwise distinct legal actors (pick_accounts); seed 7; computed before the first request

archetypes.name: recent_qty2
archetypes.select_rule: 3 smallest entry_index >= position of the entry in the corpus with pairwise distinct legal actors (pick_accounts); actor has qty=2 at recent:0; seed 7; computed before the first request

archetypes.name: final_sale_defect_claim_only
archetypes.select_rule: 3 smallest entry_index >= position of the entry in the corpus with pairwise distinct legal actors (pick_accounts); seed 7; computed before the first request

live_legal_slice.order: rounds e=1..3; within a round pairs high_value -> recent_qty2 -> final_sale_defect_claim_only; global pair number p=(e-1)*3+archetype; even p: v2 first, odd p: v2r first. Same case id and ticket id T-<archetype>-e<e> for both foundations, separate event log per foundation
live_legal_slice.admission: a pair runs only if min(run requests left, author pass requests left) >= 2L = 20 AND run tokens left >= min_tokens_per_pair AND run wall time left >= min_wall_s_per_pair; otherwise both rows are not_measured_not_admitted ('not measured'). Worst case 9 pairs x 20 = 180 > 120, so the last pairs of the last round drop first (final_sale, then recent_qty2, then high_value)

labels.a_stalled: no finalize_case call; the patient customer asked K times and left (agent_stalled)
labels.a_customer_left: no finalize_case call; customer left for another reason
labels.b_rule: finalize refused by the server with a business-rule code (not_delivered, outside_window, final_sale_not_refundable, requires_manual_review), no later success
labels.b_args: finalize refused only with argument codes (invalid_argument, code_not_permitted, not_found_or_not_owner, amount_exceeds_price), no later success
labels.b_other: finalize refused with other codes, no later success

measurement.truncated_after_finalization: limit hit after the ticket was finalized: DB outcome final, counted and flagged
measurement.not_measured_not_admitted: pair not admitted by the budget rule

live_legal_slice.pair_check: requests of a pair are byte-equal until the first differing executor response (tool message); an earlier difference is a reproducibility defect (NFR-2.3), split into model_nondeterminism (assistant message) and harness (other)
live_legal_slice.inference_rule_H1: 'H1 observed' <=> on boundary-2 >= 2 of the measured high_value episodes are lost with b_rule, AND on 2r >= 2 of the measured high_value episodes are completed, AND |completed(recent_qty2, v2) - completed(recent_qty2, v2r)| <= 1. Otherwise 'not established'. If measured < 2 in any of these cells -> 'not measured'. Absence of an effect is a valid result. Cells that measure the model: boundary-2 (high_value, final_sale) and recent_qty2 on both; the 2r high_value cell mostly confirms the routing mechanics (review N3)
live_legal_slice.H2_descriptive: share of (a) a_stalled/a_customer_left per foundation and archetype; a_stalled after K nudges = the model did not execute its promise even when asked (property of the model under this simulator), published as counts with denominators
live_legal_slice.client_mode_note: every conclusion states the client mode (facts_patient); the rev7 critic slice (L=10, n=2) used facts and is not mixed in (N1)
live_legal_slice.reproducibility: cassette + request bodies recorded; offline replay exact in verify; pair defects published
live_legal_slice.label_negative_control: rev7 events with a finalize refused only with invalid_argument are labelled b_args, not b_rule
